segments.text: are you a current GP user wondering what a move to the cloud and business Central might look like but aren't sure where to start sign up today for a free and easy GP assessment the assessment provides guidance and Direction on what your journey will look

like the assessment was designed with a few main tenants it needed to be super easy to use fast and non-intrusive and finally free and available to everyone there's no need to wait for nights and weekends to run the assessment as it can be done during business business hours While others are working in GP it also doesn't require that you've already purchased a BC license

the assessment tool only reads data from the GP SQL Server nothing is ever written or changed to your GP system after the assessment is run using the assessment removes the need for lengthy surveys and numerous meetings simply run the tool view your results and share them with your partner let's take a closer

look the first step is to fill out a quick signup form after submitting your information you will receive an email with a link to a page where you can download the tool once you log in simply select the download button and copy your unique

token after you've launched the assessment paste in your token and select next now entering a user that has access to GP SQL Server choose connect and select the companies you want to assess as a best practice it's recommended that you not include test or sample companies

now run the assessment after all tasks have been complete you can easily review the information captured by the tool before sending once you've reviewed the information select the send results button when your results have been analyzed you will receive another email with a link to your assessment

report your assessment report will look similar to this where you can review modules and features that are being used in GP drill into any isv solutions you have installed and review any potential migration risk identified by the assessment don't worry though each risk includes more details and recommendations on how to fix remember to click the share icon to share
the assessment Report with your partner now that you've had an opportunity to learn more about the GP assessment start your journey today by going out to BC migration

assessments. to learn more about business Central check out the GP tobc YouTube playlist to view short videos that show how common activities done in GP can perform be performed in business Central want to see business Central in action check out a guided tour or learn more at business Central learning courses at BC learn
